input: same RAW UTF8<=2000bytes and K2_16_1<=1000bytes from last frozen experiment; no new facts
inner_protocol: cyclic next scenario, fixed hyperparameters; no early stopping or selection on validation/heldout
augmentation_schedule: r0 vs(epoch_zero_based+seed)%5; one sample per logical step per full-batch update;120updates each
batch: one view for every training logical step, full batch; fold-specific count

B2_B3.loss: class-balanced multi-label OVR logistic BCE; train seen classes only, unseen=-1e6 ranking slots retained
B2_B3.B2_features: train r0-only vocabulary char3,4,5 min_df2 max2048; train-only smoothed IDF and sublinear TF,L2normalize; same vectorizer for both augmentation modes

B4_B9.backbone: frozen official GTE, authentic768 vectors required
B4_B9.projection: two separate linear768x32 heads,normalize,initial W_T=W_L random seeded
B4_B9.checkpoint: final epoch120 only, no early stopping
B4_B9.B4_loss: balanced sigmoid BCE: half positive mean plus half unlabeled-complement mean
B4_B9.B5_loss: full216 multi-positive crossentropy: average negative log-softmax over all known positives
B4_B9.B6_loss: same multi-positive crossentropy with32uniform sampled unlabeled, static per-step seeded pool
B4_B9.B7_loss: same32, public frozen knowledge cosine closest to any training positive, all positive IDs masked
B4_B9.B8_loss: same32, high scored training-step candidates from B5 checkpoint trained on same legal train split, positives masked
B4_B9.B9_loss: same candidate pools as B8, weight negative=1-.75*max_train_cooccurrence_fraction_with_any_positive, computed unique training steps only; reliability is risk proxy not certified truth
B4_B9.B9_CONST_control: identical B8 pools and architecture, all negative weights.5; separates variable risk from uniform downweight
B4_B9.additional_mining_cost: B8/B9 use existing B5 trained-only checkpoint; mining time separately reported; optimization update budget matched, total pipeline cost not claimed equal

equivalent_IDs: normalize frozen parent IDs; candidate216 has no distinct known equivalent alias declared, no heuristic co-occurrence merging
weak_negative_status: UNLABELED_CANDIDATE or SEMANTIC_HARD_UNLABELED; ZERO evidence-certified negatives
primary_reporting: MRR per scene/fold/seed, equal-scene mean and query-weighted summaries; paired scene effect signs and ranges, no confirmatory p-values with7 exposed dependent scenarios; seed averages not independent attacks
